title: Cheap and not worth the money
text:
Cheap and not worth the money. I bought two sets for my
Christmas village. These are very flimsy and poorly made. The bottom on some fell off the tree before I even took them out of the bag. There are only a few larger trees and the rest are very small. Some had one side crushed in and I could not use them. I think they are poorly made, very tiny. Unfortunately the price was not tiny.
